line.line: Come along, no more stops, we need to find our way to Solitude.
Why are we even going to a wedding at this far flung end of the Empire anyway?
Hmm hmm.
Ugh. Speak to my husband, if you must.
I told you, it's the wedding of Vittoria Vici, an extremely well connected merchant with the East Empire Company. The Emperor's cousin? Remember?
Indeed. If we ever get there.
Hopefully these gifts will put us in her good graces, secure that import deal, and lead the way to an audience with the Emperor.
Don't bother me, peasant. I've had a long journey and paid too much coin on these gifts to be late to Vittoria's wedding.
I'm on my way to Solitude to join the Legion. A united Empire is better for everyone.
Never should have come here...
Hhyyaarargghhhh!
Nyyarrggh!
Agh!
Nargh!
Yeagh!
Yeagh!
Gods, no!
Loyal Nords are always welcome here. Anyone else better watch their step.
You hear that? I swear there's something out there... in the dark.
Welcome to the Vilemyr Inn. If there's anything I can get you, just let me know.
Skyrim certainly has its fair share of inns.
If you're headed up to the monastery, watch your step... it's a long way down.
I'll show you to your room. Right this way.
This place almost reminds me of my homeland. Almost.
I heard the Gourmet is hiding out somewhere in Skyrim. You know, fella who wrote that cookbook.
Do not give your trust blindly, stranger, it will come back to bite you.
A pleasant journey, milady.
The road takes you many places, but sometimes it's best to pave your own.
Let me know if there's anything else you need.
Just get out of my way, I've got work to do.
Lynly, would you mind taking care of the customer please?
No problem.
Hmm hmm.
Then I guess that's your last request, fool!
You're as good as dead!
Oof!
This what you want?
That your best? Huh?
Mercy!
Agh...
Hmm hmm.
Gods... damn you!
Nuh...
Now you're mine!
Die, damn you!
Fool, I will see you dead!
Fool! I'll have your blood!
Time to die, hero!
Grrargh!
It's... nothing...
Nargh!
Nuh...
Damn you...
You won't get the best of me!
Weergh!
Yeagh!
Agghh!
Are you truly ready to die? I'll try and make this quick!
I will claw the eyes out of you, fool!
I knew I'd find you!
You ready to die today? Huh?
Nyyarrggh!
Yearrgh!
Weergh!
Argh!
Ha! I think you're bleeding!
Grrargh!
Weergh!
Nuh...
Over here!
Think you can take me?
Hey, who's there?
You - over here, quick. Before any of them show up!
Please, stranger! I need your help!
Never should have come here...
Come on!
Hyargh!
Weergh!
Nargh!
Aggghh!
Nuh...
Weergh!
Prepare to die!
Nuh...
What was that?
Until next time.
All right, then.
I'm warning you. Back off!
I'm getting out of here!
That's close enough.
Never should have come here...
Argh!
Yeagh!
Hunh...
Yearrgh!
Yearrgh!
I'm gonna kill you!
That your best? Huh?
Hyargh!
I'm getting out of here!
Hunh...
Another corpse for the pile.
Somebody help!
If you run into my husband Nazeem, remind him that he's not married to himself.
Mallus is teaching me everything he knows about brewing. Hopefully, I can take over his position some day.
By Ysmir, it's true. A jester - funny suit and all. Just north, by the Loreius Farm. Fool had a coffin in a cart, with a broken wheel.
Like to see him laugh his way out of that.
Just fists. No weapons, no magic... no crying. Let's go!
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
Well, well. Another maggot to squash beneath my boot.
Come on. Let's see what you're made of.
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
Just keep swinging!
Yearrgh!
Who taught you to fight? Keep those hands up!
Hyargh!
Come on! Keep your guard up and wait for an opening!
Good fight going here.
Yeagh!
Twelve septims on the big one!
Argh!
Agh!
Agh!
Nargh!
Yeagh!
Drive that snowback to the ground. Come on!
Come on! Let's see you put up a fight!
Nargh!
Nargh!
That the best you can do?
Fight! Fight!
Oof!
I. Will. Destroy you!
Fight! Fight!
Rrarggh!
Come on! Come on!
Agh!
Weergh!
You think I'm afraid of you?
You're no liar. Best fight I've had in years. There you are.
We'll pay whatever it takes, but we must have more swords for the Imperial soldiers.
I just can't fill an order that size on my own.
Ha! I'd sooner bend my knee to Ulfric Stormcloak.
Have it your way. I'll take the job, but don't expect a miracle.
Good day.
That's a decent weapon you've made there.
All right, then.
The name's Hjoromir, and I'm just the man for the job.
Yes?
You sure look like you could use some help.
You sure look like you could use some help.
You sure look like you could use some help.
Anything else I can do for you sir?
You want to keep helping? How about you make some armor. Make sure you have the right raw materials.
Make some armor, got it.  Just need to um...yeah... what do you mean by raw materials?
(Groan) Start by tanning some leather on the rack. A lot of weapons and armor need leather for straps, fittings, that kind of thing.
Oh, right. I knew that.
Well, one of us has to do something!
What are you doing that for?
I said no! No adventures, no theatrics, no thief-chasing!
Well, what are you going to do then, huh? Let's hear it!
We are done talking about this.
Oh, a customer. Sorry you had to hear that.
What are you doing that for?
You could? I've got some coin coming in from my last shipment. It's yours if you bring my claw back.
Now, if you're going to get those thieves, you should head to Bleak Falls Barrow, northwest of town.
So this is your plan, Lucan?
Yes. So now you don't have to go, do you?
Huh?
Oh really? Well I think your new helper here needs a guide.
Be careful!
Wh- no... I... Oh, by the Eight, fine. But only to the edge of town!
This way.
We have to go through town and across the bridge to get to Bleak Falls Barrow.
Wait, so... a costume? You're not serious...
Those thieves must be mad, hiding out there. Those old crypts are filled with nothing but traps, trolls, and who knows what else!
Sure I am. We got some furs and tree branches; paint them white and then tie them to Stump. Instant Frostbite Spider!
Frodnar... nobody is going to believe that your dog is a... Frostbite Spider. And if they do... they'll kill him. That's not much of a prank.
Oh yeah, and what would you rather do?
How about... we play tag! You're it!
Hey, no fair! Get her, Stump!
I wonder why they only stole Lucan's golden claw. I mean, we have plenty of things in the shop that are worth just as much coin.
This is the bridge out of town. The path up the mountain to the northwest leads to Bleak Falls Barrow.
Good luck. Lucan and I will be waiting for you back in the shop.
You're new around here, so I'll go easy on ya. But don't get on my bad side.
Orgnar.
Hard not to.
The ale is going bad. We need to get a new batch.
That letter ought to convince Camilla to never speak to Faendal ever again.
Come on in. Just stoked the fire. Take a seat and get the cold out.
You're that visitor, been pokin' around.
Until next time.
Until next time.
Let me guess - someone stole your sweetroll...
You're new around here, so I'll go easy on ya. But don't get on my bad side.
Welcome. Let me know if you want anything... think I got a clean mug around here somewhere.
This is a local favorite and one of the first songs I ever learned. Ragnar the Red.
Oh! There once was a hero named Ragnar the Red, who came riding to Whiterun from ole Rorikstead!
And the braggart did swagger and brandish his blade, as he told of bold battles and gold he had made!
But then he went quiet, did Ragnar the Red, when he met the shieldmaiden Matilda who said...
"Oh, you talk and you lie and you drink all our mead! Now I think it's high time that you lie down and bleed!"
And so then came the clashing and slashing of steel, as the brave lass Matilda charged in full of zeal!
And the braggart named Ragnar was boastful no moooooree... when his ugly red head rolled around on the floor!
We drink to our youth, to days come and gone. For the age of aggression is just about done.
We'll drive out the Stormcloaks and restore what we own. With our blood and our steel we'll take back our home.
Down with Ulfric the killer of kings. On the day of your death we'll drink and we'll sing.
We're the children of Skyrim, and we fight all our lives. And when Sovngarde beckons, every one of us dies!
But this land is ours and we'll see it wiped clean. Of the scourge that has sullied our hopes and our dreams.
